The '''shanjaru''' was a beast that was driven nearly to extinction at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] acquired what he believed to be the last two surviving members of the species, a male and a female, in order to serve them as part of his feast. [[Momi Andrell]] and a group of animal rights activists worked to save the shanjaru and repopulate the species. They stole the female from Drooga's [[Drooga's pleasure barge|pleasure barge]] and took genetic samples, sending them to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The male shanjaru was later delivered to Drooga by [[Risha Drayen]].<ref name="BM" />

The unorthodox scientist [[Lazhae]] claimed the species demonstrated evidence of evolving sapience, though his research was less than reliable.<ref name="BM" />
